ecosystemResearch.mcpApps: OpenAI documents ui/* JSON-RPC over postMessage as the standard MCP Apps bridge and recommends ui/message for follow-ups and ui/update-model-context for model-visible UI context.
ecosystemResearch.webmcp: Chrome documents WebMCP as an early-preview, client-side browser API; it is not a replacement for IMA's backend MCP Apps transport and should not be promoted as production truth yet.
ecosystemResearch.androidAccessibility: Android documents AccessibilityService for user-facing accessibility and controlled interaction; it requires system binding and should remain explicit/authorized. This is relevant prior art for future device adapters, not evidence that IMA has a live accessibility agent.

changes.action: Added standard ui/update-model-context before ui/message so browser URL, user message, timestamp/mode and annotation presence are carried into future model context; retained ui/message as the actual follow-up and kept explicit ACK/error boundary.
changes.evidence: GitHub commit exists. Render deployment was superseded/canceled by subsequent canonical commits, so live production behavior is NOT yet verified.

changes.action: Hardened the nested MCP Apps bridge: accept BrowserGlass-origin messages only, validate responses from known ChatGPT web origins, and preserve valid postMessage targeting.
changes.evidence: Both commits exist. The first was superseded; the second was then superseded by the later canonical doodle-refresh commit in Render's automatic deployment queue. Live behavior is NOT verified.

blockers: ChatGPT Web custom MCP server connection remains external/account-level and cannot be installed by the available Plugin Management connector; the available management surface exposes uninstall/permissions but no install/connect action.
Actual ChatGPT MCP App rendering and ui/message acknowledgement remain unverified because the current chat runtime is not itself connected to the custom IMA MCP server.
Current Render auto-deploy is continuously receiving canonical-main commits; the browser bridge changes were superseded before a stable live deployment could be verified.
No fresh Termux/Chrome device report was accessible in this run.
unknowns: Whether the current nested BrowserGlass iframe boundary will be accepted by ChatGPT's MCP Apps sandbox after metadata refresh.
Whether the ChatGPT host advertises both message and updateModelContext capabilities for this app instance.
Whether the annotation image itself is visible to the model; this change currently sends annotation presence as model context text rather than falsely claiming pixel-level model visibility.
Whether Google authentication persists through the eventual live-browser session.
next_target: Obtain a stable Render deployment containing the bridge changes, then perform the first supported ChatGPT Web MCP invocation and verify request logs plus UI rendering.
After connection, invoke ima_live_browser status/screenshot and verify an explicit ui/message acknowledgement before reporting receipt.
Verify annotation-to-model context with a real host response; if image content is supported, upgrade from annotation-presence text to a model-visible image block.
Reinspect Termux/Chrome bridge and Universal Device Action Bridge when device evidence is available.
Keep LIVE-001 as the sole canonical live-browser requirement and reconcile all future browser-agent/WebMCP/device-control work into it.
truth_boundary: Source commits and queued deployments prove implementation/deployment intent only. VERIFIED_LIVE requires independent runtime evidence from the supported ChatGPT Web MCP Apps surface and authorized device path.
